# Platoon Tours

> Platoon Tours is a Tanzanian safari operator based in Arusha, offering founder-guided safari packages across the Serengeti, Ngorongoro Crater, Tarangire, Lake Manyara, Lake Natron and Zanzibar.

Platoon Tours designs tailor-made Tanzania safari itineraries ranging from 2 to 15+ days, using 4x4 safari vehicles with pop-up roofs and professional English-speaking guides, with accommodation ranging from mid-range tented camps to luxury lodges. The company also arranges Zanzibar beach extensions and Mount Kilimanjaro add-ons.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://www.platoontours.com/): overview and featured safari packages
- [Safaris](https://www.platoontours.com/safaris): full list of safari packages with pricing, duration and itineraries
- [Destinations](https://www.platoontours.com/destinations): Serengeti, Ngorongoro Crater, Tarangire, Lake Manyara, Lake Natron, Mount Kilimanjaro
- [Zanzibar](https://www.platoontours.com/zanzibar): Zanzibar beach add-ons and highlights
- [About](https://www.platoontours.com/about): company background
- [Blog](https://www.platoontours.com/blog): safari planning guides and travel tips
- [Contact](https://www.platoontours.com/contact): inquiries and bookings
